recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of two individuals standing back-to-back in profile, set against a stark white background. The composition is anchored by a large, ornate, purple calligraphic title that arches over the subjects' heads, featuring extensive swash flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two profile silhouettes
Contrast between the dark hair/clothing and the pure white negative space
Harmonious relationship between the purple text and the purple tones in the left figure's attire
Visual bridge created by the touching hair of the two subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point where the two subjects' hair meets in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched typography, moves down the central vertical axis, and splits outward following the profiles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and sides to emphasize the silhouette and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark subjects and white background; high saturation in the purple accents.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Arched baseline following a gentle curve
Elongated, circular swashes extending from the first and last letters
Interlocking or overlapping characters in the center
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'D' features a large, looping flourish that extends below the baseline
Final 'N' features a mirrored flourish extending above the cap height
The ampersand or central connector is integrated into the surrounding letterforms

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and sharp serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man and woman standing back-to-back in profile against a solid white background. The woman on the left has a large afro and wears a purple velvet garment. The man on the right has a beard and wears a patterned dashiki. Their hair should touch in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom arched title in deep purple at the top. Use a high-contrast serif font with large, circular calligraphic swashes extending from the start and end of the text.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects in profile back-to-back?
Is the text arched and purple?
Are there decorative swashes on the typography?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is arched correctly over the heads.
Ensure the purple of the text matches the purple in the clothing.
Check that the profiles are sharp and distinct against the white.
Confirm the swashes do not obscure the legibility of the letters.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key profile photography + Arched high-contrast swash typography = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
